name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: August Week 12 - Demo
description: Practice words for demonstrating and reflecting on the dance game.

words.definition: A short demonstration of how something works.
words.example: The demo showed one full round of the game.

words.definition: A short explanation and demo of the game rules, controls, and result.
words.example: The presentation explained the game rules and controls.

words.definition: A real use for a skill or project.
words.example: The application of variables helped explain the score.

words.definition: A guide that explains how work will be graded.
words.example: The rubric helped the group check missing features.

words.definition: A short explanation of the bug fixed, improvement made, and skill learned.
words.example: The reflection named one bug and how it was fixed.

words.definition: A change that makes the game clearer or easier for players.
words.example: The improvement made the instructions clearer for players.
